events.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
events.titleJa: エージェント ノードを使用してワークフロー ステップとしてエージェントを呼び出す
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
events.summary: Add an agent node to your workflow to reason over data, call tools, and return a response, all within a single step. The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional...
events.summaryJa: エージェント ノードをワークフローに追加すると、データの推論、ツールの呼び出し、応答の返しをすべて 1 つのステップ内で行うことができます。エージェント ノードを使用すると、推論をワークフローに直接埋め込むことができます。これは、手動の引き継ぎが減り、処理時間が短縮され、追加の開発を行わずに微妙な決定を処理できるワークフローを意味します。
events.summaryEn: Add an agent node to your workflow to reason over data, call tools, and return a response, all within a single step. The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional...

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
events.titleJa: Copilot Chat で Word・PowerPoint 内の画像テキスト検索を改善
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
events.summary: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.
events.summaryJa: Copilot Chat は、Word・PowerPoint ファイル内に埋め込まれた画像のテキストも検索結果の照合に活用します。スキャンした契約書や表・画像内の文字など、これまで見つけにくかった情報を検索しやすくなります。
events.summaryEn: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.
